goal.current_capability: No complete note create/read API exists.
goal.required_capability: Create and read notes end-to-end through the API.

fixed_interfaces: Create returns an identity that read can consume.
allowed_interface_evolution: Private storage and routing implementation may change.
state_semantics: A successfully created note must be readable by its returned identity.
protected_boundaries: CLIENT requirements cannot be redefined by implementation.

charter_invalidation_events: Physical evidence falsifies the note-service capability boundary.
done_when: Create/read works on the exact candidate.
Independent review is bound to the exact terminal candidate.
